notes: Original NiceImageView is an Android native View library. This migration creates a NEW Flutter pure-Dart package from scratch, porting the Canvas rendering logic directly rather than wrapping the Android code. The Flutter package uses CustomPainter + clipPath which is a cleaner approach than the original PorterDuff xfermode technique.
